messages:
sam: PTAL — I addressed the comments from @rachel and @andrew. Split the allocator change into two commits, added a focused smoke test, and adjusted logging. CI was green locally but flaky in CI earlier. Link to diff: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/4123

rachel: looking now, nice split. left one tiny nit — please change the log from info -> debug for the rotation path so it doesn't spam production logs :slightly_smiling_face:

andrew: LGTM besides that nit. also can you add a short comment explaining why we rotate every 64 allocations (so future readers don't remove it accidentally)?

sam: done — pushed two fixes: switched log -> debug and added comment above the rotation math. also added a tiny fallback to avoid OOM when batch size == 0 (edge case). snippet: ```diff
- if (batch.size() == 0) return;
+ // defensive: empty batches can show up for degenerate clients, avoid OOM
+ if (batch.size() <= 0) return;
```

ci-bot: CI update: smoke tests failed on macos-builder-2 (test/allocator_test::rotation) — retry queued (build 4123.2).

maria: re-ran the failed job manually after the retry, smoke passed. can we schedule a canary for tomorrow 09:30 PT? pinging SRE for slot.

sre-oncall: 09:30 PT slot looks free, I can own the rollout and watch traces. plan: 10% for 15m, then 50% for 15m, then full if stable. please include monitoring hooks in the canary config.

rachel: LGTM :thumbsup:

andrew: approved, thanks for the quick followups.

sam: thanks — merging after SRE confirms canary start. FYI I kept commits separate (alloc-fix / smoke-test) so we can revert the alloc change quickly if needed.

sre-oncall: canary started at 2024-11-05T09:30:00PT. first 5m look clean (no error spikes). increasing to 50% now.

ci-bot: Merge: PR #4123 merged to main by sam (squash). Artifact: gcr/redwood/inference:4123-20241105

sam: merged and released. closing thread — thanks everyone for quick eyes :tada:
